Product Id: Canadian International Merchandise Trade (Balance of Payments Basis)
Totals are not equal to the sum of their components.
Countries listed are the top 27 principal trading partners of Canada based on annual 2012 total merchandise trade data.
The concept of Trade Balance exists only on a Balance of Payments seasonally adjusted basis.

Data for the European Union includes the United Kingdom through December 2020 reference month. Beginning January 2021, the United Kingdom ceased to be covered by trade agreements negotiated by the European Union, and is therefore not included in trade totals for the European Union effective reference month January 2021.

On December 7th, 2023, with the implementation of the North American Product Classification System (NAPCS) 2022, historical adjustments were made to all reference years prior to 2016 in balance of payments basis data to introduce estimates for illicit cannabis trade.
